$comment: Hard marginal gzip KiB ceilings for splitting-aware production ESM. Each route adds one anchored component to the representative shell in $baseline. Initial bytes include only the entry and transitively static chunks; dynamic chunks remain covered by total-cost budgets. Preserve passing canaries, shell imports and optional-peer exclusions. Reviewed increases use exact measurements or the next 64-byte boundary, with at most 4% headroom. Shared modal ordering and reconnect handling measure 19,848 initial marginal gzip bytes for tour; only its exceeded ceiling advances to 19,904 bytes. The shared visually hidden form-control label option advances only the exceeded marginal ceilings to the next 64-byte boundary. Script-aware locale lookup and the 80-locale loader table measure 1,005 initial route gzip bytes for locale-loader, and 29,323 and 9,928 marginal bytes for model-select and mention-popover; only those exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Named anchors for href menu items measure 18,204 initial marginal gzip bytes for menu; only its ceiling advances to 18,240 bytes. Build-time optional-peer import guards measure 1,083 initial route gzip bytes for locale-loader and 42,753 marginal bytes for date-input; only those exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Upgrading scoped elements after adoption, for native scoped registries in iframe and detached documents, advances only the exceeded dist/utilities/scoped-registry-loader.js route ceiling to the next 64-byte boundary above its reviewed 11,470-byte measurement. Active token-provider validation measures 30,915 marginal gzip bytes for voice-picker; only that exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary, 30,976 bytes. Releasing deferred overlay subscriptions disposed during setup measures 18,113 initial marginal gzip bytes for popover and 7,107 for citation-badge; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, 18,176 and 7,168 bytes. Locale-picker positioning-failure recovery measures 30,044 initial marginal gzip bytes; only its exceeded ceiling advances to 30,080 bytes. This release measures 29,395 initial marginal gzip bytes for model-select, 27,660 for time-input and 37,383 for select; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, 29,440, 27,712 and 37,440 bytes. Icon load ownership and active-failure handling change shared-shell compression: popup measures 4,804 initial marginal gzip bytes and export-button 14,594. Only these exceeded ceilings advance to 4,864 and 14,656 bytes, their next 64-byte boundaries; the representative shell, optional-peer exclusions and all passing canaries remain unchanged. Control theming and lifecycle repairs advance only the exceeded initial ceilings to the next 64-byte boundaries above their measurements. The shared component helpers and related repairs measure 8,164 initial marginal gzip bytes for tool-call-chip, 4,735 for usage-badge, 43,073 for date-input, 18,663 for menu, 18,548 for popover, 16,505 for tooltip, 7,227 for citation-badge, 6,628 for entity-chip, 15,036 for export-button, 10,002 for mention-popover, and 20,077 for tour. Each exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary. The combobox minimum-query route now measures 38,522 initial marginal gzip bytes; its reviewed ceiling follows the measurement down to 38,528 bytes, the next 64-byte boundary. Registering the four peer-free SVG charts adds 119 initial route gzip bytes to dist/utilities/scoped-registry-loader.js, measured at 11,599 bytes; shared slot-content and empty-state repairs measure 38,634 initial marginal gzip bytes for combobox and collection-source tracking 10,405 for mention-popover. Only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary: 11,648, 38,656 and 10,432 bytes. The combobox text commit and focus-before-render delegation measure 39,227 marginal gzip bytes for lr-combobox; only that exceeded route advances to the next 64-byte boundary, 39,232 bytes. The consistent 32.0.0 event, attribute and token names measure 29,572 initial marginal gzip bytes for color-picker and 39,238 for combobox; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, 29,632 and 39,296 bytes. The review fixes measure 39,359 marginal bytes for combobox and 11,651 route bytes for the scoped registry loader; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. The consumer-gap form-control transition and focus-outline hooks and overlay sizing tokens measure 39,447 initial marginal gzip bytes for combobox and 16,827 for tooltip; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, 39,488 and 16,832 bytes. The 32.1.0 tag manifest, part aliases and the shared runtime event base advance the exceeded initial-route and marginal ceilings to the next 64-byte boundary above their measured gzip bytes. The consumer theming tokens and options measure 39,626 initial marginal gzip bytes for combobox; only that exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary, 39,680 bytes. The final 32.1.0 combobox, popover and tooltip parity re-measure advances only those exceeded marginal ceilings to the next 64-byte boundary above their measured gzip bytes. The rebased 32.1.0 integration (Web Awesome 3.15.0 parity on top of the table and token additions) records its measured bytes; each exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary. The 33.0.0 combobox option html support, whose sanitizer itself stays a lazy chunk, measures 42,283 initial marginal gzip bytes for combobox; only that exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary, 42,304 bytes. Moving the closed-details traversal shared by focus navigation and accessibility visibility into dom-guards shrinks the representative shell and every aggregate and initial route, so marginal bytes rise against the smaller baseline: color-picker measures 29,710, combobox 42,365 and popover 19,202 initial marginal gzip bytes; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, 29,760, 42,368 and 19,264 bytes. Loading the external-label association index on first use and expanding the locale fallback chain only after the first registration shrink the representative shell by about 600 bytes and the form-control routes further: select measures 32,371, combobox 41,509, date-input 39,699, time-input 27,420, model-select 24,482, color-picker 28,902, locale-picker 29,005 and voice-picker 26,116 initial marginal gzip bytes, and their ceilings drop to the next 64-byte boundary. Against the smaller baseline mention-popover measures 10,436 bytes; only that exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary, 10,496 bytes. The lr-tooltip full-width-trigger layout measures 16,978 initial marginal gzip bytes for tooltip; only that exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary, 17,024 bytes.
